description.value: Gaya Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant occupying a unit in a strip-mall complex along Island Highway North in north Nanaimo. The restaurant offers online ordering exclusively for to-go pickup, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to grab a sushi meal on the go. A 10% discount is advertised for online orders.
